description_full: Gaotu Techedu Inc. operates as a technology-driven education company in the People's Republic of China. It provides AI-powered product-led learning solutions for learners from pre-school to adulthood. Its learning services include traditional learning services, non-academic tutoring services, and college student and adult education services; and educational content and digitalized learning products comprise books and digitalized auxiliary learning tools. The company creates learning experiences delivered through online and offline channels. The company was formerly known as GSX Techedu Inc. and changed its name to Gaotu Techedu Inc. in June 2021. Gaotu Techedu Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.

culture_narrative: Employs approximately 17K people. Revenue per employee of $53K ranks in the bottom quartile among Consumer Defensive peers, with revenue growing 19%/yr across its filed history. Each employee generates $2K of free cash flow annually. Stock-based compensation of $337 per employee reflects an ownership culture.
financial_summary: Gaotu Techedu Inc. is a small-cap consumer defensive business with a $583M market cap on $923M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +32% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are contracting by -3.1pp, the first warning that competitive pressure is eroding the franchise.
Returns on capital run at 1031% against a 9% cost of capital — a 1022-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat. Gross margins of 72% confirm genuine pricing power.
The business throws off $37M in free cash flow — roughly 4 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.

Management returns a meaningful 8.8% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 9.4% of the shares, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
